== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Death Star II: Capacitors, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 12 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of March 1, 2017” (PDF made 31 May 2017): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf DErrata.pdf]. Preserved copy of the sheet: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. SHA-1 of this file: ea45f56ab8418ec66d2d73899d379e850869f9dd. Shown on [[Death Star II: Capacitors (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].
